excerpt: A step-by-step guide for boutique owners and online sellers who want to buy kurtis directly from Jaipur manufacturers.
seo_title: How to Buy Kurtis Wholesale from Jaipur – Boutique Guide
seo_description: Step-by-step guide to buying kurtis wholesale from Jaipur manufacturers: choosing designs, MOQ, samples, payment and shipping for boutiques.
body:
Jaipur is one of India's biggest hubs for cotton and block printed kurtis. Buying directly from a manufacturer can improve your margins – if you plan well.

## 1. Decide your customer and price range

Know who you sell to: daily wear, office wear or festive. Fix the selling price first, then work backwards to your buying price.

## 2. Ask for the latest catalogue

A good manufacturer shares a fresh catalogue with fabric, sizes and wholesale price for each design.

## 3. Understand the minimum order

Most manufacturers have a minimum per design or per order. Ask whether sizes and colours can be mixed.

## 4. Order samples

Check fabric feel, print quality, stitching and fit before placing a bulk order.

## 5. Confirm everything in writing

Designs, quantity, sizes, price, delivery date and payment terms should be written in the quotation.

## 6. Payment and dispatch

Most Jaipur manufacturers work on advance payment. Ask for photos or videos of your goods before dispatch and a GST invoice.

## 7. Start small, reorder winners

Test 8–10 designs, see what sells, and reorder the best ones quickly.
